# mdown

> mdown is a media downloader that runs in the browser. You paste a link to a
> video or audio post, choose a format, and the file lands in your normal
> downloads. It is capped at 8k and 30 minutes per item, requires no account,
> and stores nothing on a server.

## What it does

- Downloads video and audio from a pasted link, in auto (video + audio), audio-only, or muted mode.
- Offers mp4, webm and mkv for video; the untouched source stream, or mp3, wav, ogg and opus for audio.
- Includes three tools that run entirely in the browser tab, with no upload:
  - **Remux** — repackages streams into a different container without re-encoding, so quality is unchanged and it finishes in seconds.
  - **Subtitle extractor** — exports embedded text subtitle tracks as SRT, and explains when a track is image-based and cannot be exported.
  - **Metadata cleaner** — strips container tags such as title, artist, comment and creation time, leaving the streams untouched.
- Accepts a media link after the domain (`https://mdown.cc/<link>`) so a download can be started from a bookmark or a message.
- Keeps settings and recent links in the browser's local storage only.

## What it does not do

- No account, no cookies, no analytics, no advertising.
- Does not host, store, index or redistribute media. Files are transferred once and deleted.
- Does not bypass DRM, logins, paywalls or region locks. Those requests fail and the error says so.
- Does not process image-based subtitles (no OCR) and cannot remove watermarks burned into frames.

## Limits

- Maximum resolution: 8k (4320p), decided by the instance.
- Maximum duration: 30 minutes.
- The downloader needs a compatible API instance; the page has no backend of its own and says so when none is configured.

## Pages

- [Home](https://mdown.cc/): the downloader, the three browser tools, and a short help section.
- [Help](https://mdown.cc/#help): how the API connection works, which formats are available, and what the site keeps.
- [Terms & ethics](https://mdown.cc/terms.html): permitted use, what is refused (DRM, paywalls, redistribution), privacy, and the no-warranty clause.
- [Status](https://mdown.cc/status.html): live health of whichever API the visitor has connected — dependency checks, queue depth and recent uptime. Not indexed, because it is per-visitor.

## Notes

- The `.cc` in the name stands for closed captions, not a company.
- The site is a static page; the tools run client-side in WebAssembly.
